description: Read operational health from a selected FrontierStack Mac: services, monitors, disks, certificates and alerts it watches.

area.description: overall (default): the Local Health board of everything the Mac monitors. queues: sanitized backlog counters for configured message brokers, streams, task queues and cloud queues (never message bodies).

mac_id.description: Opaque id of one of this account's FrontierStack Macs. Optional only when exactly one Mac is online.

name: get_server_health
title: Get server health
